items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: John said, 'You should listen to this girl sing because I think she would fit your band.' I heard her and that was it.

ctx.x: Yes. It was such a beautiful idea, too, you know, and it really caught on with him. John said, 'You should listen to this girl sing because I think she would fit your band.' I heard her and that was it.
You remember what she was singing that night?
